headline: BAL @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.52 at WSN 4.86, with a projected total of 9.38. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (BAL -0.29, WSN -0.38), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.67, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cade Cavalli has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Daylen Lile, James Wood, CJ Abrams, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler O'Neill, Jorbit Vivas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
